page.overview:
Who is Larelle Tarsi?

She had long dark hair with white wings and copper skin. She had thin eyebrows. She is elegant.

Larelle had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. At the time of New Spring, she is stronger in the One Power than Moiraine Damodred, although Moiraine would eventually be stronger once she reached her full strength.

She taught Moiraine in several classes, both as novice and Accepted and had a way of asking the question you least wanted to hear. Her pupils were torn between being intimidated by her and wanting to be her. Every girl in her classes thought her the perfect sister. She had a way of asking the last question you wanted to hear.

While Moiraine Damodred is out searching for the Dragon Reborn she meets up with Larelle in Kandor.
